verdict.rationale: Evidence only covers installing plugins/skills within the OpenAI/Codex/ChatGPT ecosystem (CLI, IDE extension, ChatGPT desktop/web/mobile) and a one-way migration path for porting a Claude Code plugin *into* OpenAI's format — it does not show the same plugin collection being installed as-is across Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex with per-harness instructions. The migration guidance (docs-32/41) actually implies conversion/rework is needed rather than a shared cross-agent install.
